name: abs
description: Returns the absolute value of a number or compatible object.

name: aiter
description: Returns an asynchronous iterator for an asynchronous iterable.

name: all
description: Returns True when every item is truthy or the iterable is empty.

name: anext
description: Returns an awaitable for the next asynchronous item or an optional default.

name: any
description: Returns True when at least one item in the iterable is truthy.

name: ascii
description: Returns a printable representation with non-ASCII characters escaped.

name: bin
description: Converts an integer-like value to a binary string prefixed with 0b.

name: bool
description: Converts a value to True or False using Python truth testing.

name: breakpoint
description: Enters the configured debugger and forwards any supplied arguments.

name: bytearray
description: Creates a mutable sequence of bytes from a size, iterable, text, or bytes-like source.

name: bytes
description: Creates an immutable bytes value from a size, iterable, text, or bytes-like source.

name: callable
description: Checks whether an object appears callable.

name: chr
description: Returns the one-character string for a Unicode code point.

name: classmethod
description: Wraps a function so a class is supplied as its first argument.

name: compile
description: Compiles source text or an AST into a code object for execution or evaluation.

name: complex
description: Creates a complex number from numeric values or a numeric string.

name: delattr
description: Deletes a named attribute from an object.

name: dict
description: Creates a dictionary from a mapping, key-value iterable, and/or named entries.

name: dir
description: Lists names available in the current scope or attributes available on an object.

name: divmod
description: Returns the quotient and remainder from dividing a by b.

name: enumerate
description: Pairs each item from an iterable with a consecutive index.

name: eval
description: Evaluates a Python expression using optional global and local namespaces.

name: exec
description: Executes Python code using optional global, local, and closure namespaces.

name: filter
description: Lazily yields items for which the function returns truthy.

name: float
description: Converts a number or numeric string to a floating-point value.

name: format
description: Formats a value using its format protocol and a format specification.

name: frozenset
description: Creates an immutable set from unique items in an iterable.

name: getattr
description: Returns a named attribute or an optional default when the attribute is missing.

name: globals
description: Returns the dictionary for the current module's global namespace.

name: hasattr
description: Checks whether retrieving a named attribute succeeds.

name: hash
description: Returns an object's integer hash value.

name: help
description: Displays interactive help for an object, topic, or name.

name: hex
description: Converts an integer-like value to a hexadecimal string prefixed with 0x.

name: id
description: Returns an integer identity that is unique for the object during its lifetime.

name: input
description: Displays an optional prompt and reads one line of user input without its trailing newline.

name: int
description: Converts a number or numeric string to an integer, optionally using a specified base.

name: isinstance
description: Checks whether an object is an instance of a class or any class in a tuple.

name: issubclass
description: Checks whether a class inherits from another class or any class in a tuple.

name: iter
description: Returns an iterator, optionally one that calls a function until a sentinel appears.

name: len
description: Returns the number of items in a sized object.

name: list
description: Creates a mutable list from the items in an iterable.

name: locals
description: Returns a mapping representing the current local namespace.

name: map
description: Lazily applies a function to items drawn in parallel from one or more iterables.

name: max
description: Returns the largest item, optionally using a key function and empty-iterable default.

name: memoryview
description: Creates a view over an object's binary buffer without copying its data.

name: min
description: Returns the smallest item, optionally using a key function and empty-iterable default.

name: next
description: Returns the next iterator item or an optional default when the iterator is exhausted.

name: object
description: Creates a new base object with no instance attributes.

name: oct
description: Converts an integer-like value to an octal string prefixed with 0o.

name: open
signature: (file, mode='r', buffering=-1, encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None, closefd=True, opener=None)
description: Opens a file and returns a text or binary stream according to the requested mode.

name: ord
description: Returns the Unicode code point of a one-character string.

name: pow
description: Raises base to a power, optionally computing the result efficiently modulo an integer.

name: print
description: Writes objects as text with configurable separators, ending, destination, and flushing.

name: property
description: Creates a managed class attribute backed by getter, setter, and deleter functions.

name: range
description: Creates an immutable sequence of evenly spaced integers.

name: repr
description: Returns an official string representation intended to be unambiguous when possible.

name: reversed
description: Returns a reverse iterator over a reversible object.

name: round
description: Rounds a number to a requested number of decimal digits.

name: set
description: Creates a mutable set containing unique items from an iterable.

name: setattr
description: Assigns a value to a named attribute on an object.

name: slice
description: Creates a slice object describing a start, stop, and step.

name: sorted
description: Returns a new sorted list from an iterable.

name: staticmethod
description: Wraps a function so it receives no automatic instance or class argument.

name: str
description: Creates a human-readable text representation of an object.

name: sum
description: Adds items from left to right starting with an optional initial value.

name: super
description: Creates a proxy that searches for methods after a class in the method-resolution order.

name: tuple
description: Creates an immutable tuple from the items in an iterable.

name: type
description: Returns an object's type or dynamically creates a class.

name: vars
description: Returns the attribute dictionary for an object or the current local namespace.

name: zip
description: Lazily groups items from multiple iterables by position.

name: capitalize
description: Returns a copy with the first character capitalized and the rest lowercased.

name: casefold
description: Returns an aggressively lowercased copy suitable for caseless comparisons.

name: center
description: Centers the text in a field of width characters using an optional one-character fill.

name: count
description: Counts non-overlapping occurrences of sub within the optional slice.

name: encode
description: Encodes the text into bytes using the requested codec and error policy.

name: endswith
description: Checks whether the text or optional slice ends with a suffix or tuple of suffixes.

name: expandtabs
description: Replaces tab characters with spaces using the requested tab-stop width.

name: find
description: Returns the lowest index of sub in the optional slice or -1 when it is absent.

name: format
description: Formats replacement fields in the string using positional and named values.

name: format_map
description: Formats named replacement fields using values read directly from a mapping.

name: index
description: Returns the lowest index of sub or raises ValueError when it is absent.

name: isalnum
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is alphanumeric.

name: isalpha
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is alphabetic.

name: isascii
description: Checks that the string is empty or every character is ASCII.

name: isdecimal
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is a decimal character.

name: isdigit
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is a digit.

name: isidentifier
description: Checks whether the string is a valid Python identifier; keywords still count as identifiers.

name: islower
description: Checks that all cased characters are lowercase and at least one cased character exists.

name: isnumeric
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is numeric.

name: isprintable
description: Checks that the string is empty or contains only printable characters.

name: isspace
description: Checks that the string is nonempty and every character is whitespace.

name: istitle
description: Checks that cased words use title case and at least one cased character exists.

name: isupper
description: Checks that all cased characters are uppercase and at least one cased character exists.

name: join
description: Combines an iterable of strings with this string placed between each item.

name: ljust
description: Left-aligns the text in a field of width characters using an optional fill.

name: lower
description: Returns a copy with all cased characters converted to lowercase.

name: lstrip
description: Removes leading whitespace or leading characters found in chars.

name: maketrans
description: Builds a character translation table for use with translate.

name: partition
description: Splits once at the first separator and returns before, separator, and after parts.

name: removeprefix
description: Removes prefix when present; otherwise returns the original string unchanged.

name: removesuffix
description: Removes suffix when present; otherwise returns the original string unchanged.

name: replace
description: Returns a copy with occurrences of old replaced by new, optionally limiting replacements.

name: rfind
description: Returns the highest index of sub in the optional slice or -1 when absent.

name: rindex
description: Returns the highest index of sub or raises ValueError when it is absent.

name: rjust
description: Right-aligns the text in a field of width characters using an optional fill.

name: rpartition
description: Splits once at the last separator and returns before, separator, and after parts.

name: rsplit
description: Splits from the right and returns a list, optionally limiting the number of splits.

name: rstrip
description: Removes trailing whitespace or trailing characters found in chars.

name: split
description: Splits the string into a list using a separator or runs of whitespace.

name: splitlines
description: Splits at line boundaries and optionally keeps the line-ending characters.

name: startswith
description: Checks whether the text or optional slice begins with a prefix or tuple of prefixes.

name: strip
description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace or characters found in chars.

name: swapcase
description: Returns a copy with uppercase characters lowercased and lowercase characters uppercased.

name: title
description: Returns a title-cased copy in which words begin with uppercase characters.

name: translate
description: Maps or removes characters according to a translation table.

name: upper
description: Returns a copy with all cased characters converted to uppercase.

name: zfill
description: Pads a numeric string on the left with zeroes while preserving a leading sign.

name: append
description: Adds one object to the end of the list in place.

name: clear
description: Removes every item from the list in place.

name: copy
description: Returns a shallow copy of the list.

name: count
description: Counts how many list items compare equal to value.

name: extend
description: Adds every item from an iterable to the end of the list in place.

name: index
description: Returns the first index of value in the requested range or raises ValueError.

name: insert
description: Inserts one object before the requested index in place.

name: pop
description: Removes and returns the item at index; the last item is used by default.

name: remove
description: Removes the first item equal to value or raises ValueError when absent.

name: reverse
description: Reverses the order of the list in place.

name: sort
description: Sorts the list in place using an optional key function and descending order.

name: close
description: Flushes buffered data and closes the file; further I/O operations will fail.

name: detach
description: Separates and returns the underlying binary buffer, leaving the text wrapper unusable.

name: fileno
description: Returns the operating-system file descriptor used by the stream.

name: flush
description: Writes buffered output to the underlying file immediately.

name: isatty
description: Checks whether the stream is connected to an interactive terminal.

name: read
description: Reads and returns up to size characters, or all remaining text when size is omitted.

name: readable
description: Checks whether the stream supports reading.

name: readline
description: Reads and returns one line, optionally limited to size characters.

name: readlines
description: Reads lines into a list, optionally stopping after approximately hint characters.

name: reconfigure
description: Changes supported text-stream encoding, newline, error, and buffering settings.

name: seek
description: Moves the stream position relative to the start, current position, or end and returns the new position.

name: seekable
description: Checks whether the stream supports changing its position.

name: tell
description: Returns the current stream position.

name: truncate
description: Resizes the file to size or the current position and returns the resulting size.

name: writable
description: Checks whether the stream supports writing.

name: write
description: Writes text to the stream and returns the number of characters accepted.

name: writelines
description: Writes an iterable of strings without adding separators or newline characters.

name: buffer
description: The underlying buffered binary stream for a text file.

name: closed
description: True after the file has been closed.

name: encoding
description: The character encoding used by this text stream.

name: errors
description: The configured encoding-error handling policy.

name: line_buffering
description: Whether output is automatically flushed at line boundaries.

name: mode
description: The mode originally used to open the file.

name: name
description: The file name or descriptor supplied when the stream was opened.

name: newlines
description: The newline forms encountered while reading in universal-newline mode.

name: write_through
description: Whether text writes pass immediately to the underlying binary buffer.
